text:
katie: quick follow-up to the rollout metadata thread. small proposal: add an optional `compat_level` enum + a short `compat_id` fingerprint. purpose: let client resolvers prefer likely-compatible variants when everything else (latency/cost) is equal. thoughts?

li: short summary of fields? please paste example.

katie: sure: 
```
{
  "anchor": "classify-v3@2026-07-01",
  "compat_level": "minor",   // none|minor|major|breaking
  "compat_id": "b2:9f3a..."
}
```

omar: fine as tie-breaker. two operational q's: 1) who computes `compat_id` (onboard pipeline?) and 2) can we guarantee hints won't split traffic unexpectedly?

jin: compute at ingest using tokenizer+cfg fingerprint (cheap). regarding split risk: make resolver use hint only for tie-breaking and add server handshake as final guard. safe-default: `none` for older models.

li: +1 for conservative semantics. add telemetry: `resolver.hint_applied` and `resolver.hint_mismatch`. will help gate turning on.

omar: pin pools: do not let hints drive eviction. OK for intra-pool node selection but not for affinity decisions.

katie: agreed. rollout plan: schema nullable, backfill offline, resolver behind feature flag, telemetry, then flip. will draft tiny schema diff.

schema-bot: ACTIONS: 1) katie: PR draft for registry schema. 2) jin: onboarding job spike. 3) li: add telemetry counters. 4) omar: confirm pin-affinity no-op. ETA EOW.

katie: thanks all — i'll post the PR link when ready :thumbsup:
